'''Scott White''' (also known as Scotty White) was a Decipher-era [[Squadron Members|Squadron Member]], listed as Red 21 from Tyngsboro, MA.<ref name="sm-fan" /> The published fan table marks the slot Retired after Decipher's SWCCG run.

[[File:Scott White DragonCon 2010.jpg|thumb|right|220px|White at DragonCon 2010]]

He hosted three Kashyyyk Regional qualifiers in a row and a Star Trek CCG Regional, and ran demos at the Star Wars: Special Edition theater releases.<ref name="decsq-prof" />

Decipher recruited volunteer Squadron Members in the 1990s to promote SWCCG locally (tournaments, demos, player support). "FL" is printed on some slots in the surviving tables; the tables do not spell out the abbreviation.
